absent_records.title: Manager, Growth Marketing (REMOTE)
absent_records.description: WHO WE ARE EnableComp earned its reputation in the toughest corners of the revenue cycle by solving the complex claims no one else could. We developed Complex Revenue Intelligence™ (CRI), a smarter approach to predict and prevent revenue loss. Powered by the e360 RCM® AI-driven platform and the most expansive complex revenue cycle data set, today EnableComp helps more than 1,000 hospitals nationwide recover $3 billion annually from complex claims, denials, and revenue recovery. By cutting through complexity, we help hospitals thrive, resulting in recognition as Black Book’s #1 Specialty RCM provider for complex claims and revenue integrity in 2024 and 2025, a multi-year Top Workplaces honoree, and a SOC 2 Type II and HITRUST e1-certified platform. Our Vision is to empower healthcare providers to focus on patient care, not revenue cycle complexity. Our Mission is to uncover what others miss—turning every client dollar recovered into insight that helps prevent future loss. We live our Core Values of Uncompromising Integrity , Ecstatic Clients , and Empowered Team Members by operating with trust, accountability, and a “we before me” mindset. We pursue Innovation and Profitable Growth through continuous improvement and thoughtful problem-solving, and we believe work should include Fun —celebrating success, recognizing our people, and maintaining healthy work-life balance. POSITION SUMMARY The Manager, Growth Marketing owns EnableComp’s demand generation engine — planning and executing the multi-channel campaigns that build pipeline, and, as our first dedicated content hire, creating the blog posts, ebooks, landing pages, and nurture content those campaigns run on. This role builds on the technical infrastructure the GTM Engineer maintains and the positioning the Director, Product Marketing sets, translating both into campaigns that generate and nurture qualified leads. Reporting to the VP, Marketing, the Manager will partner closely with Product Marketing, the Commercial Enablement Director, the Manager of Event Marketing & Strategic Partnerships, and the SDR function to ensure a consistent, well-coordinated path from first touch to qualified pipeline. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports at this time. \n The Job Responsibilities Include Plan, build, and execute multi-channel demand generation campaigns across email, paid social, SEM, retargeting, and organic channels. Own marketing-sourced pipeline targets and report on campaign performance against revenue goals. Manage the demand generation budget, tracking spend against ROI and reallocating based on channel performance. Own funnel content end-to-end: blog posts, ebooks/guides, landing pages, and nurture email copy that fuel campaigns — this is our first dedicated content hire, so the expectation is building the engine, not just staffing it. Ensure all campaign content reflects current positioning and messaging maintained by the Director, Product Marketing. Establish a scalable, repeatable content calendar and production workflow. Build and manage lead nurture email programs and campaign workflows inside HubSpot, working within the lead scoring and account routing logic the GTM Engineer designs and maintains. Partner with the GTM Engineer on campaign-specific automation needs and data requirements, without owning the underlying tech stack, integrations, or scoring/routing architecture. Monitor and troubleshoot campaign-level workflow issues, escalating systemic or infrastructure issues to the GTM Engineer. Partner with the Manager, Event Marketing & Strategic Partnerships on webinar and event promotion strategy, registration goals, and post-event lead nurture (Events owns strategy, logistics, and execution; Growth Marketing owns the pipeline goals and follow-up). Partner with the Director, Product Marketing to ensure campaigns and content reflect current narrative, positioning, and competitive messaging. Partner with the SDR function on lead handoff, MQL quality feedback, and conversion tracking. Analyze campaign and content performance data to identify what’s working, kill what isn’t, and continuously optimize for MQL volume, conversion rate, and cost per acquisition. Stay current on emerging channels and AI-powered marketing/content tools, piloting new tactics to keep programs ahead of the curve. Other duties as assigned. Requirements & Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field required; equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered. 3–5 years of experience in demand generation, growth marketing, or a related B2B marketing role. Experience in healthcare, healthcare technology, Revenue Cycle Management (RCM), or another complex B2B industry is a plus. Hands-on experience with marketing automation platforms (HubSpot preferred) and CRM systems (Salesforce). Strong writing skills — comfortable independently drafting blog posts, email copy, and landing page copy, since this role owns content without a dedicated content team behind it. Strong analytical skills, with experience pulling and interpreting campaign data to make decisions. Comfort partnering with a technical GTM/RevOps function (e.g., a GTM Engineer) on automation and data needs without owning the underlying systems. Regular and predictable attendance. Must have strong computer proficiency and understand how to use office applications, including MS Office (PowerPoint, Word, Excel, Teams, Outlook), Zoom, and other learning technology. To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Special Considerations & Prerequisites Practices and adheres to EnableComp’s Core Values, Vision and Mission. Individual contributor role; no direct reports at this time. A great candidate is self-directed and comfortable owning ambiguous, cross-functional problems; treats data hygiene as non-negotiable; and can translate technical workflows into plain-language impact for Sales and Marketing stakeholders. Strong project management and prioritization skills; comfortable running multiple campaigns simultaneously. A bias toward experimentation and iteration, including piloting AI-enabled content and marketing tools. Minimal travel required (less than 20%), primarily for occasional team or company offsites. Ability to work at a computer for extended periods; standard office or remote work environment. \n EnableComp is an Equal Opportunity Employer M/F/D/V. All applicants will be considered for this position based upon experience and knowledge, without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, marital, disabled or veteran status. We are committed to creating and maintaining a workforce environment that is free from any form of discrimination or harassment. EnableComp recruits, develops and retains the industry's top talent. As the employer of choice in the complex claims industry, EnableComp takes pride in our continuous commitment to building and maintaining a culture centered around fostering the professional growth and development of our people. We believe that investing in our employees is the key to our success , and we are dedicated to providing them with the tools, resources, and support they need to thrive and grow their career here. At EnableComp, we are committed to living up to our core values each and every day, and we believe that this commitment is what sets us apart from other companies. If you are looking for a company that values its employees and is dedicated to helping them achieve their full potential, then EnableComp is the place for you. Don’t just take our word for it! Hear what our people are saying: “I love my job because everyone shares the same vision and is determined and dedicated. People care about you as a person and your professional growth. There is a genuine spirit of cooperation and shared goals all revolving around helping each other.” – Revenue Specialist “I enjoy working for EnableComp because of the Core Values we believe in. EnableComp stands true to these values from empowering employees to ecstatic clients. This company is family oriented and flexible, along with understanding the balance of work, life, and fun.” – Supervisor, Operations

Configure and maintain necessary data connectors and APIs to route web data seamlessly into downstream platforms, including the Incorta platform and BigQuery. Web Operations (MarTech) Manage web tracking and workflow logic to ensure a high-quality, clean flow of lead data from web forms directly into the CRM. Qualifications Experience: 7+ years of progressive experience in digital marketing, with a minimum of 3+ years managing web infrastructure and digital advertising at a Manager level or equivalent. Webflow Expertise: Deep, hands-on expertise with Webflow is required, including CMS utilization, custom code integration, and performance optimization. Digital Advertising Mastery: Proven expertise in managing significant budgets and driving performance across major paid advertising platforms (Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, etc.). Analytical Skills: Highly proficient in web analytics tools (Google Analytics 4 is a must) and advanced spreadsheet/data analysis skills. Technical Fluency: Understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript as they relate to front-end development, tracking implementation, and performance debugging. Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical and performance data to non-technical stakeholders.

absent_records.description:
The Role : Seer is hiring a Demand Generation Manager to own the systems, programs, and measurement infrastructure behind our demand gen strategy. This is a hands-on, individual contributor role on a 3-person marketing team, reporting to Director of Marketing. You'll own HubSpot campaigns and programs as our MOPs owner, newsletter growth and engagement, webinar and digital event programs (including owned and third-party event registration through conversion), lifecycle nurture programs, demand gen asset coordination, automations for tracking, flagging, and repurposing content across channels, and KPI ownership and reporting on outbound MQLs, program conversion, and event engagement. This role is not a content creation role, blog and editorial live with our content team, so you'll focus on distribution, repurposing, and program performance. We're looking for someone who has actually built in a marketing automation platform: built workflows, set up campaigns and emails, run a newsletter, not just logged into one. Experience with events across different regional markets is a plus, and industry background matters less than platform depth. 
 Role Highlights: Campaigns: Build and run demand campaigns end to end, sequencing what the team produces across email, social, events, comms, paid, and outbound rather than letting it ship one-off Programs: Own our newsletters end to end: strategy, curation, production, reporting. Own the Signal webinar series and our event and conference presence, from promotion through logistics through follow-up PR, comms, and 3rd-party presence : Run the programs that put us in front of new audiences (press and referral partners, and the conferences where our people speak), and convert that exposure into owned-audience growth and warm conversations handed to growth. Execution in HubSpot: Own our HubSpot instance end to end, build and launch campaigns, emails, workflows, and lifecycle steps, and maintain the architecture as our MOPs owner Distribution loop: Take what our content team writes & publishes, test formats and channels, read performance, and scale what works Measurement: Own program KPIs and marketing reporting. Keep a defensible view of what's working that informs what we build next Applied AI: use AI to accelerate program production, enablement, and case study work without flattening our voice Essential Skills You've run B2B demand generation end to end: campaigns, newsletters, webinars, events, and owned the number attached to them You've been hands-on in a marketing automation platform. You've built and launched in HubSpot or comparable, not just briefed someone else to You have strong program management instincts: you can hold a campaign map and a run-of-show for a webinar in your head at the same time You have strong writing skills (though you'll have content support) and can execute a case study or review blog posts as needed You believe in building repeatable systems over one-off execution Bonus You have hands-on channel experience in more than one discipline (e.g., SEO + Paid, or Paid + Analytics) You have a background in Client Engagement, Account Management, or a client-facing strategy role and have been responsible for organic account growth You have experience in a digital agency environment where you've pitched or contributed to pitches for new clients You have familiarity with tools like Pipedrive, HubSpot, or LinkedIn Sales Navigator 30/60/90 30 Days Learn the systems, the data, and the current program calendar Begin take over newsletter production Help Establish the performance-tracking rhythm and 3/6-month targets 60 Days Take on the webinar program end to end, including promotion and logistics Run one campaign end to end across at least three channels Take on day-to-day HubSpot campaign execution from RevOps 90 days Support building measurement system for program performance in place Put trackable reporting for campaigns, events, and enablement in place Propose and implement one net-new performance improvement

absent_records.title: Demand Generation Manager
absent_records.description:
About The Sales Factory The Sales Factory (TSF) is one of North America's leading outsourced sales organizations, helping B2B technology companies accelerate revenue growth through world-class sales development. As we continue to grow, we're investing in building a scalable demand generation engine that drives a qualified pipeline, supports our sales team, and strengthens our position in the market. We're looking for an experienced Demand Generation Manager to own and execute our demand generation strategy, driving measurable business growth through integrated, data-driven marketing campaigns. About The Role This is a hands-on role for a marketer who loves building pipeline. As our Demand Generation Manager, you'll be responsible for developing and executing multi-channel marketing programs that generate qualified leads, improve conversion throughout the funnel, and contribute directly to revenue growth. You'll work closely with Sales and Leadership to identify growth opportunities, optimize campaigns, and ensure marketing efforts align with business objectives. If you're someone who enjoys testing, measuring, optimizing, and continuously improving performance, we'd love to meet you. 
 What You'll Do Develop and execute TSF's demand generation strategy across paid, owned, earned, and lifecycle marketing channels. Plan and manage integrated campaigns designed to generate qualified pipeline and accelerate revenue growth. Manage paid acquisition programs across LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads, and other digital advertising platforms. Create and optimize email marketing campaigns, lead nurturing programs, and marketing automation workflows. Partner closely with Sales Leadership to align marketing initiatives with revenue objectives and pipeline targets. Optimize landing pages, conversion paths, and lead capture strategies to improve campaign performance. Analyze campaign effectiveness using marketing and sales data, making recommendations based on key performance metrics. Build dashboards and regularly report on marketing performance, including pipeline contribution, conversion rates, CPL, CAC, ROI, and campaign effectiveness. Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external partners to execute high-impact marketing initiatives. Stay current on emerging marketing trends, AI tools, and best practices to continuously improve performance. What We're Looking For 5+ years of experience in B2B demand generation, growth marketing, or digital marketing. Proven experience building and executing successful demand generation campaigns that drive measurable pipeline growth. Experience marketing SaaS, technology, or other B2B solutions. Hands-on experience managing paid media campaigns, including LinkedIn Ads and Google Ads. Strong experience with HubSpot or a comparable marketing automation platform. Experience measuring campaign performance using marketing analytics and CRM reporting. Strong understanding of lead generation, lead nurturing, conversion optimization, and full-funnel marketing. Highly analytical with the ability to translate data into actionable insights. Excellent project management and communication skills. Comfortable working independently in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. Nice to Have Experience with ABM (Account-Based Marketing) strategies. Familiarity with Salesforce or other CRM platforms. Experience using AI-powered marketing tools. SEO and content marketing experience. Experience supporting SDR or BDR organizations. What Success Looks Like In your first 6 months, you'll: Launch and optimize scalable demand generation campaigns. Increase the volume and quality of inbound pipeline. Improve marketing-to-sales conversion rates. Build reporting that provides clear visibility into campaign performance and marketing ROI. Become a trusted partner to Sales Leadership by delivering measurable pipeline growth. Why Join TSF? Join one of North America's fastest-growing outsourced sales organizations. Own a high-impact function with direct visibility into company growth. Work remotely with a collaborative, high-performing team. Opportunity to shape and scale TSF's marketing strategy. Competitive compensation, benefits, and opportunities for career growth. 
 $8,000 - $95,000 a year The expected base salary for this position is $80,000–$95,000 CAD annually, plus performance-based bonus opportunities. Final compensation will be based on experience, skills, and overall qualifications. In addition, we offer comprehensive health benefits, generous paid time off, company holidays, and the flexibility of a fully remote work environment.

absent_records.title: Integrated Marketing Manager
absent_records.description: About Bobbie Bobbie makes European-style organic infant formula manufactured end-to-end in the U.S., because we believe every parent deserves to feed their baby with confidence, without judgment and without compromise. That's who we are, and that's what you'd be joining. Highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple priorities under tight deadlines and across initiatives Experience using Asana and Figma  Strategic & executional —ability to think at a high-level and be in-the-weeds of the day-to-day of marketing operations You’re inspired by our core values: Be Radical - We are change makers, rule breakers and stigma shakers. We are unapologetically bold and use our megaphone for good. Nurture the Tension - Parenthood is full of healthy tension , and so is building a company. We embrace the unknowns, practice humility and are a culture of learners. Deliver Ounce by Ounce - Our customers have entrusted us to feed their babies. We lose sleep over the details, so they don’t have to. Don’t Assume - We embrace our unique perspectives, withhold judgment, and find beauty in the paths that brought us all to Bobbie. Our strength is celebrating each other and our collective voice. Compensation and Benefits: Compensation  Our salaries are based on paying competitively for our size and industry. Overview of the Position We are seeking a strategic, analytical, and data-driven Marketing Operations Manager to own the reporting, measurement, and operational intelligence that enable Marketing leadership to make informed business decisions. This role serves as the operational bridge between Marketing, Revenue Operations, Finance, and Data Engineering — translating business needs into scalable reporting frameworks, standardized operating processes, and AI-enabled insights across multiple business units. The ideal candidate is a curious, highly analytical, and results-oriented professional who enjoys solving business problems through data, process, and technology — not a marketer who moved into operations. absent_records.description: Role Description Dropbox is hiring a Senior Partner Marketing Manager, AI & ISV Ecosystem to help define how Dropbox shows up in the next generation of AI-powered work. As AI and productivity platforms rapidly reshape how people create, access, and collaborate around content, this role will lead some of Dropbox’s most important ecosystem marketing opportunities. You will develop joint go-to-market strategies and high-impact programs with strategic technology partners—including OpenAI, Anthropic , and other leading AI and productivity platforms—while unlocking new growth opportunities across Dropbox’s broader integration ecosystem. You will lead and develop a small team of partner marketers, operating as a true player-coach: setting direction, prioritizing the biggest opportunities, creating the conditions for your team to do their best work, and helping them grow as strategic marketers, while also contributing to hands-on execution. You will also serve as a senior marketing partner across Business Development, Partnerships, Product, Product Marketing, Sales, and Communications, turning technical integrations and partnership opportunities into compelling customer stories, differentiated value propositions, and integrated programs that drive adoption, awareness, pipeline, and growth. This role owns partner-specific go-to-market strategy, joint positioning, integrated activation, evergreen co-marketing, and performance optimization for Dropbox’s priority AI and ISV relationships; partner selection, commercial agreements, product-roadmap decisions, sales execution, and partner-systems administration remain owned by the corresponding Business Development, Product, Sales, and Operations teams. This role is designed for a strategic builder, creative marketer, and people leader who thrives where technology, partnerships, and go-to-market intersect. You will identify where Dropbox can create disproportionate value across the ecosystem, shape joint strategies with influential external partners, and lead complex initiatives from early opportunity through launch, activation, measurement, and scale. You will join Dropbox at a pivotal moment as AI changes how people interact with their content and where work gets done. This is an opportunity to help shape Dropbox’s position in the emerging AI ecosystem, work alongside some of the world’s most influential technology companies, build a high-impact team, and create the partner marketing models that will help define Dropbox’s next phase of growth. AI is already embedded in this workflow. You will use approved AI tools to accelerate partner research, insight synthesis, campaign ideation, content development, launch planning, and performance analysis—and you will help build better AI-enabled workflows for the team while maintaining rigorous human judgment, review, and accountability. Responsibilities Set the strategy and build the roadmap : Closely partner with Business Development to define the partner strategy, and own Dropbox’s partner marketing strategy across priority AI and ISV partners, translate business and customer priorities into a clear portfolio of bets, and create the roadmap, prioritization criteria, and operating approach needed to execute against them. Personally build and execute high-priority programs : Lead the most strategic and complex partner marketing initiatives from concept through launch and optimization, including developing joint value propositions, campaign briefs, go-to-market plans, content strategies, activation plans, and partner-facing deliverables—not simply directing the work from a distance. This manager personally leads programs that are highly ambiguous, executive-visible, or strategically consequential, while direct reports own defined partner programs end to end.  Create an evergreen co-marketing engine: Build repeatable programs that extend strategic partnerships beyond launch moments, including joint campaigns, customer stories, lifecycle activation, events, content, partner amplification, and other motions that drive sustained awareness, adoption, engagement, pipeline, and revenue objectives. Turn strategy into scalable operating mechanisms: Design and implement partner segmentation, reusable launch frameworks and templates, decision rights, operating cadences, measurement approaches, campaign governance, and joint investment planning that help the team move faster and scale successful programs across the ecosystem. Lead partners and cross-functional execution: Build trusted relationships with strategic partners and work hands-on with Partnerships, Product, Sales, Marketing, and other stakeholders to resolve dependencies, navigate competing priorities, make tradeoffs, and drive complex programs to completion. Lead, coach, and work alongside the team: Manage and develop partner marketers while remaining close enough to the work to unblock execution, raise the quality bar, coach through difficult partner situations, model strong craft, and step directly into priority programs when senior-level ownership is needed. Build AI-enabled ways of working: Use approved AI tools directly in partner research, synthesis, planning, content development, personalization, and analysis; identify and implement repeatable AI-enabled workflows for the team; and maintain clear human review and accountability for strategy, quality, partner commitments, and business outcomes. Requirement B2B marketing experience: 8+ years of B2B marketing experience, with significant experience in partner, ecosystem, platform, or strategic alliances marketing, with demonstrated ability to set strategy and then personally build the plans, programs, processes, and deliverables required to execute it. Deep partner marketing craft: Demonstrated experience developing joint value propositions, go-to-market strategies, integrated campaigns, launch plans, and evergreen co-marketing programs with technology, SaaS, platform, AI, or ISV partners. Strong execution under ambiguity: Proven ability to take an underdefined opportunity, create structure, determine what needs to be built, and drive work from initial concept through execution, measurement, iteration, and scale. Analytical and data-informed decision-making: Strong analytical mindset with the ability to synthesize performance data, customer and partner insights, market signals, and qualitative inputs to evaluate opportunities, diagnose performance, make prioritization decisions, and determine what to scale, change, or stop. Exceptional writing, messaging, and communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to develop, translate, and critically review joint messaging with partners; distill complex product and ecosystem concepts into clear customer value propositions; and communicate recommendations, tradeoffs, and decisions effectively to senior internal and external stakeholders. Cross-functional influence and player-coach leadership: Experience building trust and driving decisions across partners, Product, Partnerships, Sales, and Marketing while managing and developing high-performing marketers, raising the quality bar, and stepping directly into complex work when senior ownership is needed. AI-enabled operating mindset: Demonstrated experience applying AI or automation to real marketing or business workflows, with the judgment to use AI for leverage while validating outputs and retaining human accountability for strategic decisions, partner relationships, messaging quality, and business outcomes. Preferred Qualifications AI and technology ecosystem experience: Experience working within AI, SaaS, productivity, collaboration, cloud, developer-platform, or other rapidly evolving technology ecosystems and with major strategic technology partners. Zero-to-one program building: Experience creating a new partner marketing program, capability, operating model, or repeatable motion from the ground up rather than inheriting a fully established playbook. Launch-to-evergreen expertise: Experience turning major integrations, announcements, or partner launches into sustained co-marketing programs that continue driving customer and business outcomes after launch. Commercial and measurement fluency: Experience connecting partner marketing programs to adoption, engagement, pipeline, revenue, or other meaningful business outcomes and using performance signals to decide what to scale, change, or stop. PLG + SLG experience: Experience using product adoption and customer signals alongside partner and Sales motions to drive user growth, pipeline, expansion, or revenue. Durable Skills AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve: Awareness: U nderstand yourself and others . Judgment: E valuat e information and mak e decisions in complex situations . Adaptability: L earn, adjust, and stay effective through change . Connection: C ommunicat e , collaborat e , and build trust . To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this  blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser. Compensation US Zone 1 This role is not available in Zone 1 US Zone 2 $185,100 — $250,500 USD US Zone 3 $164,600 — $222,600 USD

absent_records.title: Associate Director, SEO - Remote US
absent_records.description: WHY DEPT®? We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA. We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter. At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build. THE ROLE: As The Associate Director, SEO, is a strategic leader responsible for steering organic growth for high-complexity, high-value accounts. You move beyond day-to-day execution to act as a senior consultant, bridging the gap between technical SEO and the broader media landscape. You are an expert at identifying how organic search can integrate with Paid Search, Content, and PR to create a "Total Search" advantage. As a leader within the craft, you are responsible for maintaining senior client relationships and ensuring our SEO strategies are driving tangible business results. The Associate Director, SEO, is a strategic leader responsible for steering organic growth for high-complexity, high-value accounts. You move beyond day-to-day execution to act as a senior consultant, bridging the gap between technical SEO, AI-driven discovery, and the broader media landscape. You are a pioneer in the shift toward Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), ensuring our clients remain visible as search evolves into an answer-engine world. As a leader within the craft, you are responsible for maintaining senior client relationships, driving the SEO portion of new business pitches, and ensuring our strategies—spanning technical, content, and authority—drive tangible business results. WHAT YOU’LL DO: Direct long-term SEO and GEO strategies for enterprise accounts, ensuring visibility across traditional SERPs and AI-driven surfaces (LLMs, AI Overviews, etc.). Lead the integration of SEO with other media disciplines (Paid Search, Social, PR) to maximize visibility and drive a cohesive "Total Search" strategy. Serve as a senior strategic advisor to clients, presenting complex data-driven roadmaps and identifying "Growth Invention" opportunities that expand their digital footprint. Architect comprehensive authority-building programs, overseeing the integration of strategic outreach and digital PR tactics to drive domain equity and brand trust. Providing high-level oversight and technical expertise on site migrations, headless architecture, and advanced schema implementations. Lead the integration of SEO with other media disciplines (Paid Search, Social, PR) to maximize visibility and drive a cohesive "Total Search" strategy. Drive agency growth by contributing to the scoping, strategy, and presentation of SEO/GEO for new business pitches and existing account expansions.  Identify and lead organic growth opportunities within existing client relationships, contributing to the agency’s revenue targets through proactive account expansion. Serve as a senior strategic advisor to clients, presenting data-driven roadmaps that prove the ROI of organic search to C-suite stakeholders. Stay at the forefront of search innovation, including AI-driven search (SGE), voice search, and advanced data visualization for SEO. Directly manage and mentor a team of Managers and Associates, fostering a culture of high performance, technical excellence, and career progression. WHAT YOU BRING: 5–7 years of SEO experience, with a proven track record of leading strategy for large-scale or enterprise-level clients. Proven experience in people management (3+ years preferred), with a passion for developing talent and building high-performing teams. Strong expertise in Technical SEO—while this is a leadership role, you must be able to "speak geek" fluently and navigate complex technical environments (JS rendering, API-driven SEO, advanced crawling, migrations, headless CMS, etc.). A deep understanding of the evolving AI search landscape and a clear vision for how GEO integrates into a modern organic strategy. Experience in business development, including a talent for scoping projects and a high "win rate" in lead-room pitch environments. Advanced understanding of the "Total Search" philosophy—how Paid and Organic search work better together. High-level proficiency in SEO enterprise tools (Botify, BrightEdge, Screaming Frog) and data visualization platforms (Looker Studio, PowerBI). A "better together" attitude, with the leadership presence to influence cross-functional internal teams and senior-level client stakeholders. Preferred experience with holistic search strategies that bring synergy between both Paid and Organic channels. WHAT DO WE OFFER? We are a collaborative, open-door, best-idea-wins environment that fosters personal and company growth and has fun doing it. Here is a snapshot of our  benefits package: Healthcare, Dental, and Vision coverage 401k plan, plus matching PTO Paid Company Holidays Parental Leave WE SUPPORT YOU BEING YOU:  DEPT® is an equal opportunity employer (EOE). Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. absent_records.title: Director of Social & Organic Marketing
absent_records.description: About Eve Eve is redefining legal technology for plaintiff law firms, and we're building the team that will take us there. We help firms handle more cases, recover more for clients, and grow with AI that works across every stage of a case, from intake through resolution. The next generation of great plaintiff firms will be AI-Native, and Eve is how they get there. But what makes Eve different isn't just the product. It's how we build it. If you're someone who takes ownership, stays curious, and wants to build AI that's already changing how  law is practiced, this is where you belong. Product-market fit: Eve is trusted by over 1000+ law firms, and we’re growing fast. Backed by top investors: We’ve raised over $160M from world-class partners including Spark Capital, Andreessen Horowitz(A16z), Menlo Ventures, and Lightspeed. Built by a world-class team: Engineers, designers, and operators from places like Scale, Meta, Airbnb, Cruise, Square, Rubrik, and Lyft are building Eve from the ground up. AI-Native from day one: We’re on the bleeding edge of AI, collaborating directly with teams at OpenAI and Anthropic to build best-in-class AI workflows tailored for legal work. Explosive growth: We are growing 2X revenue Quarter over Quarter. The Role We’re hiring our first Director of Social Media to put Eve into the world, document it, and build the team that scales the motion. This is not a content calendar job. Eve’s social strategy starts in the physical world. Eve is a character out in the world doing things worth watching. (Like facilitating a legal access workshop for free consultations to people who need a lawyer. Or setting up a falafel cart outside a courthouse, plaintiff lawyers only. You get the idea!) Your job is to make those things happen, capture them beautifully, and put them into the world. Social is also where the market forms its first impression of Eve; where a plaintiff attorney decides we’re worth a demo, and where a great engineer or marketer decides we’re worth a career. You’ll own both. Your job is to make Eve impossible to miss: the premier name in legal technology to our customers, and one of the best places to work in the world to the people we want to hire. You’ll own organic strategy, channel management, and production across all of Eve’s social presence; Instagram, LinkedIn, Reddit, X, YouTube, and wherever our audience goes next. You’ll build our creator and influencer program from zero. You’ll run our employee evangelism program, turning the team into a distribution engine. And you’ll build the executive presence of our leaders, including the CEO, CPO, CRO, and CMO. You’ll start as a team of one with a real budget and a mandate to build; the function, the production motion, and the team behind it. You’ll be hands-on from day one, on set and in the edit, coordinating with our agency and external partners to ship daily while setting the strategy a growing team will execute. We want someone who can plan a quarter of campaigns and then get fingers on the phone and cut the reel; someone with the strategic range to design the motion and the craft to make fifteen seconds of video land in your chest. If you’ve built social at a brand people recognize, if you think in hooks and formats, if you’ve ever talked your way into a location to get the shot, this is the role for you. What You’ll Do Own organic social strategy, management, and production across all of Eve's channels; Instagram, LinkedIn, Reddit, X, YouTube, and emerging platforms; from the quarterly plan to the post that ships this afternoon. Create the campaigns that put Eve in the real world. Activations, stunts, field interviews, press moments, documentary shoots. Concept them, produce them, and turn them into assets that travel. Produce the content yourself, not just brief it. Write posts, direct and shoot on location, cut short-form video, and ship at the pace social demands while raising the bar on craft. Build Eve's creator and influencer program from scratch. Find the right voices in and around plaintiff law, structure the partnerships, and hold the work to our standard. Launch and run Eve's employee evangelism program. Give the team the tools, templates, and encouragement to become a distribution engine. Build the executive presence of Eve's leaders, including the CEO, CPO, CRO, and CMO; ghostwrite, shape, and grow their voices on social. Build Eve's brand across two audiences at once: plaintiff attorneys (our customers) and the people we want to hire (our future team). Run the budget. You'll have real money for production, creators, and paid amplification behind select posts. Decide where it goes, place bets that won't pay off evenly, and be honest about which ones worked. Hire and lead a social team over time. Start as a team of one and build the function, with a budget behind you. Own the numbers, including when they're lying. Grow reach and engagement across every channel; build the measurement that separates a post that traveled from a post that mattered, and be the one who says which is which. Position Eve as the premier company in legal technology and one of the best places to work in the world. Partner with content, brand, and recruiting so social reinforces the story everywhere it shows up, from the feed to the careers page. Stay ahead of platform trends, formats, and culture; move fast when something new works. What We’re Looking For 10+ years in social media, content, or brand, including time owning strategy and production for a brand people recognized. A portfolio of social work you can point to: accounts you grew, formats you invented, posts that broke out. A genuine maker; you personally write, shoot, and edit short-form content, and you ship daily. Deep native fluency across Instagram, LinkedIn, Reddit, and X; you know what works where and why. Proven ability to grow an executive’s or founder’s presence on social, including ghostwriting, format, and cadence. Experience building or running an employee advocacy or evangelism program. Instinct for what makes people stop, feel something, and share; you understand the difference between reach and resonance. Excellent writing and taste. Our audience is attorneys and top-tier operators; they notice everything. Comfort building from zero and leading a team as it grows. Bonus Points You’ve grown a brand’s social from small to genuinely known. Experience with employer branding or recruiting-driven social. Experience marketing to attorneys, professional services buyers, or another skeptical, high-expertise audience. A track record on Reddit specifically; you understand the community and its rules. You’ve built a social or content team, not just joined one. You’ve worked at a company going through hypergrowth and thrived in the chaos **Please provide a link to your portfolio when applying! We're excited to see your work! absent_records.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
absent_records.description: About Faire Faire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline. At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town — we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores. With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive. We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours. About this role Product Marketing at Faire is a strategic function embedded across the product lifecycle. PMMs partner closely with Product, Design, Marketing, and Revenue to shape programs from the ground up, develop positioning and messaging, lead GTM strategy, and drive awareness and adoption. We have PMMs focused on each side of the marketplace: the brands who sell on Faire, and the retailers who buy from them. We're looking for a senior product marketer who can own a meaningful product area, build GTM strategy from scratch, and grow their remit over time as business needs shift. This is a role for someone who makes complex products feel simple to customers, moves comfortably between strategy and execution, and brings clarity to ambiguous problems across a cross-functional team. Positioning and messaging Develop deep customer understanding for your product area and translate those insights into clear, compelling positioning. Make Faire feel simple to customers. Cut jargon, kill messaging that doesn't matter, and push back on product complexity that won't land. Sharpen the positioning of products that already have a story, repositioning them so they land with a new or shifting audience. Hold the thread across multiple launches in your area, surfacing a coherent narrative rather than a stack of individual product stories. GTM strategy and execution Build and own end-to-end GTM strategy for your product area, from positioning through launch and adoption. Ship directionally right launches fast. Comfortable making calls with 70% of the information and adjusting after, rather than waiting for perfect. Execute across multiple channels, sequencing customer education to drive behavior change at the right moments in the journey. Coordinate cross-functional enablement across Revenue, CX, Lifecycle, and other partners to bring GTM plans to life. Act as a customer-centric thought partner to Product, Design, Legal, and other stakeholders as your products evolve. Get involved upstream and shape roadmaps through customer insight. Team and craft Spend real time with customers and bring their POV into strategic conversations. Ground decisions in research and feedback rather than internal assumptions. Use AI tools to sharpen and accelerate your work, and contribute to a culture of peer learning on the PMM team around how we experiment with and adopt AI. Qualifications Required 6+ years of product marketing experience, or an adjacent role with direct ownership of positioning, messaging, sales enablement, and GTM strategy for complex products. Track record of building positioning from scratch and reworking the positioning of existing products, then driving consistency across multiple channels. Builder who makes order from chaos. Comfortable when the path isn't obvious, and energized by the chance to create structure where there is none. Experience building thematic campaigns across product areas, not just siloed launches. Uses data to size opportunities, measure impact, and pressure-test strategy. Fluent in the metrics that move the business. Experience conducting or directing customer research and translating findings into positioning. Actively experiments with and adopts AI tools to sharpen and accelerate their work, and helps the team find real ways to use AI in PMM craft. Nice to have Familiarity with how independent retailers or small business owners make decisions and what earns their trust. Two-sided marketplace background, where brand and buyer motions are distinct but interdependent Background in STEM, management consulting, finance, or other quantitative fields. Experience in high-growth or scaling environments where PMM infrastructure was still being built. Salary Range San Francisco:  The pay range for this role is $ 148,000   - $ 203,500  per year.  This role will also be eligible for equity and benefits. Actual base pay will be determined based on permissible factors, including transferable skills, work experience, market demand, and primary work location. The base pay range provided is subject to change and may be modified in the future. Hybrid Faire employees currently go into the office 3 days per week on Tuesdays, Thursdays, and a third flex day of their choosing (Monday, Wednesday, or Friday). Additionally, hybrid in-office roles will have the flexibility to work remotely up to 4 weeks per year. Specific Workplace and Information Technology positions may require onsite attendance 5 days per week as will be indicated in the job posting.  Why you’ll love working at Faire Move fast: You'll own meaningful problems that serve customers around the globe with the agency to move fast and see your results clearly. Equipped to scale: We invest in what matters, including the latest enterprise AI tools, to help you work smarter and get more out of every day. Best in class: Our team is full of sharp, kind, and generous colleagues who care about their craft and about helping you grow in yours. Real rewards. Competitive pay, equity, and comprehensive benefits designed to support your life inside and outside of work. Belonging: We're intentional about building an environment where every Faire employee has equal access to opportunities, growth, and success. Faire was founded in 2017 by a team of early product and engineering leads from Square. We’re backed by some of the top investors in retail and tech including: Y Combinator, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Forerunner Ventures, Khosla Ventures, Sequoia Capital, Founders Fund, and DST Global. We have headquarters in San Francisco and Kitchener-Waterloo, and a global employee presence across offices in Toronto, London, and New York. absent_records.description: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . Working within regional priorities, you are trusted to make decisions, adapt plans as conditions change, and take ownership of program performance from planning through results. Approximately 50% of your work is self-directed, requiring sound judgment, strong prioritization, and accountability for outcomes. Success in this role comes from balancing execution with strategic thinking, identifying opportunities for improvement, and sharing best practices that increase team effectiveness. You are expected to leverage AI as a core part of your work, applying it thoughtfully to improve productivity, scale repeatable processes, and enhance decision-making. This includes identifying where AI can create efficiencies, where human judgment remains essential, and developing workflows that can be adopted across the team. The AI workflows you build get picked up by others, so the team produces more without adding headcount. You find and close process gaps, and the junior teammates you guide do better work for it. absent_records.description: Gong harnesses the power of AI to transform how revenue teams win. The Gong Revenue AI Operating System unifies data, insights, and workflows into a single, trusted system that observes, guides, and acts alongside the world’s most successful revenue teams. Powered by the Gong Revenue Graph, AI-powered intelligence, specialized agents, and trusted applications, Gong helps more than 5,000 companies around the world deeply understand their teams and customers, automate critical sales workflows, and close more deals with less effort. For more information, visit www.gong.io. At Gong, you will join a company built on innovative products, ambitious goals, and passionate people. We are shaping the future of revenue intelligence and we want people who are excited to build what comes next. You will work with a team that dreams big, moves fast, and cares deeply about the craft and about each other. Here, transparency and trust are core to how we operate, and every person has the opportunity to make a visible impact. If you want to grow, stretch, and do work that truly matters, Gong is the place to do the best work of your career. Gong is looking for a Senior Director of Growth Marketing to lead our Organic, Paid Media, and Paid Search functions. This is a pipeline generation role first: you'll own the strategy and results across our paid and owned channels, and you'll be measured on the pipeline and revenue those channels produce. What's changed is how that pipeline gets built. Buyers increasingly discover and shortlist vendors through content, AI-driven search, and channels well outside a traditional demand generation funnel, so we want a leader who treats earning attention there as a direct driver of pipeline, not a separate initiative running alongside it. That means bringing a creator's instincts to this work alongside the instincts of a traditional growth leader: a real point of view on what earns attention today, hands-on experience building it, and enough range across organic, paid, and web channels to know where to place the bet. This is fundamentally a leadership role, not an individual-contributor one. But we've found that leaders who've done the work themselves are better at coaching a team to do it well. RESPONSIBILITIES Paid Search — our largest growth investment, and the channel with the most existing operational maturity Paid Media — LinkedIn, Display (via Demandbase), and YouTube, roughly equal in weight to each other and collectively comparable in size to Paid Search Organic & AI Search — SEO, plus AEO/GEO (answer- and generative-engine optimization): owning our visibility, citation rate, and share of voice inside AI answers (ChatGPT, Anthropic, Google AI Overviews/AI Mode, Copilot, Gemini) as buyers increasingly research and shortlist vendors there before they ever reach our site Earned channel influence — Reddit, YouTube, Wikipedia, analyst platforms like Gartner, and other sources that shape how AI engines and buyers perceive Gong; you won't own execution here, but you'll partner closely with the teams who do (PR, AR, Social) to make sure our presence there is deliberate Website partnership — you'll shape strategy and priorities for web initiatives in close partnership with the Web team, though they won't report into you. In the AI era, that includes making sure the site is machine-readable and extractable (clean structure, schema, answer-shaped content) so LLMs can retrieve and cite it — not just optimizing for human UX QUALIFICATIONS  15+ years in growth or performance marketing, including 5+ years managing managers (not just individual contributors) with real ownership of Paid Search, Paid Social, and SEO/AEO Experience owning a growth budget with a scale of more than $20M annually across multiple channels  A track record of tying growth activity to commercial outcomes; owning pipeline and revenue contribution, and efficiency metrics like CAC, pipeline-per-dollar, or blended CPA, across paid and owned channels A track record of managing budgets in the range this role will own, with clear evidence of efficiency AND experimentation (not just one or the other) Strong measurement instincts with comfortability building attribution and testing frameworks that prove what's working, including in channels that are inherently harder to measure precisely Experience partnering cross-functionally with Web/Design/Brand/PR/AR teams without owning them directly A bias toward testing new channels early, with a point of view on where audiences are moving next Experience using digital channels to break into new industries or geographies People leadership experience with a demonstrated coaching style that empowers rather than controls B2B SaaS experience preferred; comfort with complex, considered sales cycles a plus Direct, hands-on experience creating content meant to capture attention — social-native video, founder-led content, influencer-style formats — not just briefing others to make it Nice to have: A personal or professional portfolio of content you've created and grown an audience with (a newsletter, a YouTube channel, a LinkedIn following, TikToks, etc.) HOW YOU WILL LEAD Treat your team as owners, not direct reports. Set the bar, give context, and get out of the way. No micromanagement of channel tactics. Push for exponential, not incremental. Anyone can optimize a CPC by 8%. We want a leader who asks "what would 10x this channel?" and is willing to test the answer. Create room for risk. Your team should feel safe running the experiment that might fail, because you've made it clear that swinging and missing is part of the job — not swinging is the problem. Bring a creator's eye to the whole portfolio. Push each channel owner to think like a creative, not just a media buyer — including in channels like Paid Search, where that mindset is less common but just as valuable. Model the behavior you want from the team. Be willing to write, shoot, or edit something yourself to test a new format before asking the team to scale it. Build the bench, not just the output. Actively develop future leaders on the team, raise the hiring bar with every open req, and address performance gaps directly rather than working around them. PERKS & BENEFITS  We offer Gongsters a variety of medical, dental, and vision plans, designed to fit you and your family’s needs. Wellbeing Fund - flexible wellness stipend to support a healthy lifestyle. Mental Health benefits with covered therapy and coaching. 401(k) program to help you invest in your future. Education & learning stipend for personal growth and development. Flexible vacation time to promote a healthy work-life blend. Paid parental leave to support you and your family. Company-wide recharge days each quarter. Work from home stipend to help you succeed in a remote environment. The annual salary hiring range for this position is $195,000 - $290,000 USD.  Compensation is based on factors unique to each candidate, including, but not limited to, job-related skills, qualification, education, experience, and location. At Gong, we have a location-based compensation structure, which means there may be a different range for candidates in other locations. The total compensation package for this position, in addition to base compensation, may include incentive compensation, bonus, equity, and benefits. Some of our sales compensation programs also offer the potential to achieve above targeted earnings for those who exceed their sales targets.  We are always looking for outstanding Gongsters! So if this sounds like something that interests you regardless of compensation, please reach out. We may have more roles for you to consider and would love to connect. absent_records.title: Principal Product Marketing Manager, Enterprise Context
absent_records.description: About Glean:   Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles.   At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.   Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.   If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more - deeply embedded where people get things done. You’ll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company. About the Role: Glean is looking for a Principal Product Marketing Manager, Glean Enterprise Context to define and execute the go-to-market strategy for the technologies that power reliable, enterprise-grade AI. Enterprise AI is at its root the intersection of AI and enterprise data and you will shape telling this story in the market. This role will translate advances in context, connectors, indexes, Enterprise Graphs, semantic layers, ontologies, into clear product narratives, differentiated market positioning, and practical resources that help customers understand Glean Enterprise Context. You will work at the intersection of product, engineering, research, sales, and communications. You will stay close to the rapidly evolving data and AI landscape, develop a strong point of view on where the market is going, and bring Glean’s technical advantages to life through launches, customer communications, thought leadership, technical collateral, and field enablement. This is a highly visible, hands-on role for a product marketer who can engage deeply with technical teams, understand how modern data systems work, and communicate complex ideas with precision and impact. You will help establish Glean as a technical leader in the next generation of enterprise AI. You will:  Own the product marketing strategy and go-to-market plans for Glean Enterprise Context, including new connectors, search quality, Enterprise Graph, structured data, memory, and the context that provides high-quality AI experiences. Partner with Product and Engineering to translate architecture, technical tradeoffs, roadmap priorities, and customer value into differentiated positioning, messaging, launch plans, and customer-ready narratives. Lead end-to-end launches for platform capabilities—from audience and release strategy through communications, technical documentation, field enablement, customer education, and post-launch adoption—while establishing repeatable launch processes. Define Glean’s point of view on the emerging new context stack for AI; create compelling technical content and customer stories that show how teams can measure, improve, and trust AI applications and agents. Represent Glean Enterprise Context as a technical spokesperson; and equip Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Partners with the proof points and architecture they need to drive adoption. About you:  8+ years of B2B SaaS product marketing experience, or related field BA/BS in business, marketing, liberal arts, or related degree Bring significant experience in data platforms, AI systems, or a related technical category Understand modern AI data systems deeply, including RAG, indexing, knowledge graphs, semantic layers, ontologies, and enterprise data architectures Closely follow the AI industry and bring technical credibility with Product, Engineering, Research, developers, and technical buyers, translating complex technical decisions and market developments into clear customer and business implications. This is a 100% remote position with an opportunity to work a hybrid schedule for candidates who live near our global headquarters in Chicago. Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and is sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and be responsible for driving brand recognition and high-quality sales pipeline via in-person and digital events. This role will require travel to domestic events up to 20% of the time. About the Role The Senior Event Marketing Specialist will report to the Director of Global Event Marketing and own Keeper's demand generation event strategy, coordinating closely with the marketing team, sales leaders and cross-functional teams to plan, execute and analyze the impact of demand gen events, including public sector demand gen events. Responsibilities Lead end-to-end planning and execution of demand generation events across the Americas, including Tier 1 conferences and trade shows (e.g. RSAC, Black Hat, Identiverse) Develop and execute comprehensive marketing plans for corporate, public sector and demand generation events, ensuring alignment with Keeper’s strategic goals Oversee inventory management systems, including swag and trade show assets Collaborate with design teams and event stakeholders to create compelling event materials, ensuring alignment with branding and strategic objectives Support managing event logistics, including vendor negotiation, budget management, booth design and on-site coordination from conception to completion Partner with sales and marketing operations to track event-sourced pipeline and report on ROI against demand gen targets Provide end-to-end event marketing support across sales teams, including public sector and commercial teams as needed, tailoring approaches to meet the needs of each segment Proactively manage the events list and internal calendars Maintain flexibility and a proactive approach by stepping in to support various projects as needed to ensure smooth execution Willingness and ability to travel up to 20% of the time to support on-site event execution  Stay up-to-date with industry trends and identify opportunities to enhance our event marketing strategy Requirements 5+ years of experience in event marketing, preferably with a SaaS company Experience leading large-scale conferences/trade shows (e.g. Black Hat, RSA, Identiverse) and smaller-scale events Ability to drive complex, multi-stakeholder and cross-team programs Results-driven self-starter who strives for excellence  Confident team player with the ability to operate in a dynamic environment Outstanding verbal and written communication skills Strong business acumen, analytical and detail-oriented Proficient with Google Workspace and Microsoft Office tools Preferred Experience working within the cybersecurity industry Experience using CRM and marketing automation platforms like Salesforce or HubSpot for event-related lead tracking and follow-up Experience using project management platforms like Monday.com Benefits Medical, Dental & Vision (inclusive of domestic partnerships) Employer Paid Life Insurance & Employee/Spouse/Child Supplemental life Voluntary Short/Long Term Disability Insurance 401K (Roth/Traditional) A generous PTO plan that celebrates your commitment and seniority (including paid Bereavement/Jury Duty, etc) Above-market annual bonuses Keeper Security, Inc. is an equal-opportunity employer and participant in the U.S. Federal E-Verify program. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Classification: Exempt   Keeper Candidate Privacy Notice This notice explains how Keeper Security processes your personal data during recruitment. Depending on the role and location, the Controller of personal data (the organization responsible for determining why and how personal data is processed) will be Keeper Security Inc. (US), Keeper Security EMEA Ltd. (Ireland), or Keeper Security APAC K.K (Japan). 1. Data We Collect Information You provide: Contact details, CV/resume, cover letter Employment history, qualifications, work eligibility Application responses and uploaded documents Information We generate: Interview notes, assessments, communications Scheduling information Information From Others: Recruiter/referral information who submit your profile References (with your consent, before final offer) Public professional profiles Background verification (post offer) Voluntary Diversity and Equal Opportunity Information We may ask you to voluntarily provide diversity information including race/ethnicity, gender, disability status and veteran status (US). Providing this information is optional and Keeper collects this data in order to comply with EEOC and similar requirements 2. How We Use Your Data Assess your application and suitability Manage interviews and recruitment workflow Consider you for other/future roles (we may seek your consent to keep your information on our systems beyond the retention period specified) Comply with employment law obligations 3. Legal Basis Legitimate Interests (recruitment management, security and integrity of the hiring process) Contracting steps (for progressed candidates) Legal and regulatory compliance obligations; explicit consent where required 4. Who We Share Information With Internal: HR, hiring managers, interviewers*, IT support for system administration *Note - diversity and equal opportunity data is not shared with hiring managers. Third Parties: Service providers who assist with: Applicant tracking, recruitment systems and assessment providers Background verification vendors (post offer) Recruitment agencies (where applicable) Tools to support communication, collaboration and to securely store your data Keeper ensures that all our third parties are contractually bound to protect your personal data with adequate safeguards in place. 5. International Transfers Your data may be accessed by Keeper entities globally as needed for the purposes of hiring and decision making. We protect any such data transfer between Keeper entities using appropriate safeguards under applicable data protection laws. 6. Security We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data, consistent with our industry leading security standards. 7. Retention We keep your data for 24 months from your last application activity, then delete or anonymize it. Exceptions: You opt into our talent database for further retention by providing consent (extended retention) You're hired (transfers to employee records) 8. Your Rights You have the following rights and can contact us at the email below to exercise them: Access, correct, or delete your data, subject to applicable law and retention requirements Object to or restrict processing Withdraw consent (where applicable) Request data portability Lodge a complaint with your data protection authority If you become an employee, your rights regarding your employee record are governed by our internal Employee Privacy Notice and certain data will be retained as required under relevant laws such as employment or tax law.  When you request access to your personal data, some information may be redacted if it includes the personal data of other individuals or information that we must protect in order to preserve their privacy rights. 9. Automated Decisions Keeper does not make hiring decisions using solely automated processing. 10. Contact - Candidates can send privacy questions to: privacy@keepersecurity.com

absent_records.description: WHO ARE WE? Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including FinanceBuzz , All About Cookies , and OnlyInYourState . We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies. Our mission: create predictable, high-value customer acquisition at scale by connecting discovery, intent, and performance across category-leading consumer brands in finance, travel, and entertainment. We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries. WHY JOIN US? You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato.  BASE SALARY: $120,000 to $150,000 per year, paid semi-monthly MUST HAVE: Expert SQL & Comfortable with Unstructured Complex Data : Extracts accurate insights from raw, unstructured data without relying on clean models Reporting Ownership & Data Literacy : Builds, standardizes, drives adoption, and leaves teams more data-literate Performance Marketing Optimization : Connects data directly to levers that move the business, i.e. campaign performance, conversion rates, or revenue per session Advanced LookML Development (or equivalent in Power BI / Tableau) : Architects complex models with full understanding of downstream impacts Curiosity & Business Depth : Asks questions first; driven to grow business knowledge to become a trusted analytical partner, not just a builder EXPERIENCE: Minimum 7 years in business intelligence or analytics with direct exposure to performance or affiliate marketing. The strongest candidates have owned reporting end-to-end, from pipeline to dashboard, worked with messy, complex, third-party data, and partnered closely with business teams to uncover meaningful trends, conduct retrospective analyses, and connect data work to decisions that actually moved the business. YOUR ROLE Launch Potato is looking for a Lead BI Developer to own the reporting infrastructure that powers decision-making across our Credit Cards, Make Money/Manage Money, Banking, and Marketplace verticals with a clear growth path into becoming a proactive analytical partner who helps the team see around corners. You'll be embedded with the business from day one, partnering closely with our Yield, Paid Media, and Account Management teams to uncover meaningful trends, conduct retrospective analyses across experiments, creatives, offers, seasonality, and CAC performance, and challenge the team with insights they aren't currently seeing. This is NOT a role for someone who wants to build dashboards and hand them off, it's for someone who cares deeply about whether the work they build gets used, understood, and acted on. Outcomes (Performance Expectations) 30 Days in: Actively engaged with stakeholders to audit what reporting the team is consuming and why, i.e. identifying discrepancies, redundancies, and inconsistencies across existing dashboards and beginning to develop a roadmap to standardize reporting across your verticals. 60 Days in: Bridging business context and data understanding by being able to articulate how assigned verticals make money and what the key performance levers are. Actively improving dashboard standardization while executing on ad hoc requests with accuracy and business context. 90 Days in: Dashboard standardization is in execution and a clear roadmap exists for how trusted data sources will be developed to improve the efficiency of data consumption. LookML structure is understood well enough to begin making changes with full awareness of downstream impacts. Working relationships with Yield, Paid Media, and Account Management are established. 6 Months in: Trust is built with the business team through education, best practices, and a standardized reporting suite that enables confident self-service analytics. Proactive retrospective analyses are being delivered across experiments, creatives, offers, seasonality, and CAC performance. Strong understanding of the full funnel metrics that support each team. Year 1: Trusted technical owner for assigned verticals end-to-end, from raw data ingestion through final dashboard. Reporting standardization is complete, retrospective analysis is a consistent output, and the business team views you as a go-to analytical partner who recommends action, not just reports findings. Competencies Analytical Rigor: Asks the hard questions and traces discrepancies to the source before drawing conclusions. Reporting Ownership: Engages stakeholders to understand how reporting is used before building, i.e. creates dashboards that are adopted, not just delivered. Business Acumen: Invests in understanding the business by asking the right questions before pulling the data. Communication: Asks enough upfront to make sure the answer lands with the right context for the right audience. Proactive Ownership: Surfaces problems early, engages before being asked, and drives work forward with a clear point of view. Collaboration: Builds trust by asking genuine questions and showing they care about what stakeholders need, not just what they asked for. Curiosity & Growth: Asks more than most and is driven to grow from technical executor into analytical partner over time. TOTAL COMPENSATION Base salary is set according to market rates for the nearest major metro and varies based on Launch Potato’s Levels Framework. Your compensation package includes a base salary, profit-sharing bonus, and competitive benefits. Launch Potato is a performance-driven company, which means once you are hired, future increases will be based on company and personal performance, not annual cost of living adjustments. Want to accelerate your career? Apply now! Since day one, we've been committed to having a diverse, inclusive team and culture. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity company. We value diversity, equity, and inclusion.  We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.
