absent_records.title: Demand Generation Marketing Manager
absent_records.description: Who we are: Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks. Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector. Visit gomotive.com to learn more. What we’re looking for We're looking for someone who brings a marketer's curiosity and a builder's mindset to the Mid-Market segment. You understand the market we serve, the buyers you're reaching, and what moves them to act all while maintaining enthusiasm to solve challenges physical operations organizations face. You're always sharpening the axe: questioning assumptions, testing new approaches, growing your AI skill set and looking for ways to make the next campaign better than the last. You enjoy comfortable operating in ambiguity and a fast-paced environment where priorities shift and are not discouraged by blockers, but motivated to find solutions. If this sounds like you, read on!   Role Responsibilities Plan, execute, and optimize Programmatic ABM campaigns and full-funnel demand generation campaigns across dmid-market, and working with other segment leads to ensure large scale campaigns accurately capture ICP for all segments/personas.  Partner closely with the Content Marketing, Customer Marketing and PMM team to map existing content to the buyer's journey, identify content gaps, and request new content and sales collateral to support campaign objectives. Maintain target account lists and apply a working understanding of buyer funnel stages, definitions, and conversion benchmarks to inform targeting and messaging decisions. Partner with Marketing Operations to ensure accurate targeting, list hygiene, and campaign setup, flagging issues and driving resolution proactively. Collaborate with Product Marketing to apply established messaging frameworks to campaigns and adapt messaging for segment-specific needs. Develop campaign and creative briefs independently, including copy direction, messaging hierarchy, and design inputs that align to buyer journey stages. Campaign and ABM Execution Partner with channel owners to launch and monitor campaigns across: 6sense Display, LinkedIn, Additional Display channels, Content Syndication, Email, Web, Events/Field, Associations. You will not be responsible for hands on keyboard but work with partners to understand how each channel works individually and collectively to drive new pipeline across buying committees.  Own execution for select channels, including: Webinars, Calendared Sales Plays, and partnering on Direct Mail: managing end-to-end setup, targeting, launch, and performance tracking. Ensure channel execution aligns to defined campaign messaging and buyer journey stages, making adjustments based on performance data and segment feedback. Evaluate channel activations and performance and make strategic decisions based on segment and buyer needs, reallocating spend or effort when warranted. Build testing and iteration cycles into each campaign to gain a larger understanding of demand generation learnings.  Leverage AI tools and agentic workflows to accelerate campaign personalization, sales play development, and insight generation — applying a working knowledge of AI to streamline day-to-day execution without sacrificing quality. Sales Partnership and Enablement Partner with SDRs, AEs, and sales leadership to align marketing campaigns with outbound and inbound motions, ensuring marketing programs support sales priorities and pipeline goals. Enable sales teams to act on campaign engagement by providing targeting direction, messaging, sales plays, and enablement materials. Maintain regular communication with sales partners to share campaign performance, upcoming programs, and recommended actions, and to incorporate sales feedback into campaign planning. Contribute to weekly sales communications that summarize active marketing initiatives, upcoming programs, and sales actions. Prepare materials for sales meetings and planning sessions, tailoring content to the audience. Attend select sales meetings to stay aligned on priorities and feedback, advocating for marketing programs and incorporating sales input into campaign planning. Reporting and Optimization Monitor campaign performance and pipeline contribution against goals, identifying trends, risks, and optimization opportunities independently. Partner with Marketing Analytics to maintain dashboards and reporting cadences; partner with Marketing Operations and Sales Operations to maintain Outreach dashboards and sales command centers in Salesforce.  Analyze performance data to understand what is working and why, making recommendations for reallocation or adjustment. Contribute to weekly Mid-Market metrics updates with clear, actionable insights. Support ad-hoc reporting needs for WBRs, MBRs, and QBRs as requested, translating data into recommendations for leadership. Qualifications 5+ years of experience in B2B demand generation, campaign management, or growth marketing (not including internships). Proven track record of executing multi-channel demand generation campaigns that drive measurable pipeline contribution beyond just events. Hands-on experience with ABM strategies, including 1:Few and 1:Many campaign motions. Experience partnering with sales teams (SDRs, AEs) to align marketing campaigns with outbound and inbound motions. Working knowledge of marketing automation platforms and CRM systems (Salesforce, Marketo) Comfortable analyzing campaign performance data in Excel/Google Sheets and Tableau, with the ability to derive insights and make data-informed decisions. Strong project management skills with experience in Asana or equivalent tools. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create compelling campaign briefs and sales enablement materials. Experience required: Salesforce (required), Asana, Sendoso (or equivalent), Outreach. Glean, Clay (preferred) Location: Austin, TX, Nashville TN or San Francisco (2-3x a week in the office)  This is an individual contributor role  Pay Transparency Your compensation may be based on several factors, including education, work experience, and certifications. For certain roles, total compensation may include restricted stock units. Motive offers benefits including health, pharmacy, optical and dental care benefits, paid time off, sick time off, short term and long term disability coverage, life insurance as well as 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). Learn more about our benefits by visiting Motive Perks & Benefits . The compensation range for this position will depend on where you reside. For this role, the compensation range is: United States $89,000 — $111,000 USD Creating a diverse and inclusive workplace is one of Motive's core values. Proactively collaborate with a team of indirect reports (centralized marketing subject matter experts) across digital channels, AEO/SEO, and web, to execute on the highest impact strategies in your vertical. Rigorously measure the efficacy of tactics/channels/funnel and continuously optimize via experimentation. Align marketing portfolio bets to maximize impact. Regularly report on marketing performance and strategy to leadership / exec team. Set the standard for AI-first marketing in tooling, planning, and agent building, deploying AI workflows that transform impact. Work closely with marketing leadership across other verticals (auto, aesthetics) and partnering functions (design, product marketing) to prep for launches, align on resourcing and positioning. Align with Sales, CS, Product, Finance, and Revenue Operations leaders on goals and priorities. Hands-on depth across relevant marketing channels like trade shows, field or partner marketing, lifecycle, webinars, content marketing, digital, and ABM. The position also serves as a people leader, responsible for managing, developing, and mentoring members of the Marketing Operations team while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and operational excellence. The position serves as the operational hub of the Marketing organization, providing visibility into all active initiatives, driving continuous improvement, and ensuring efficient collaboration across marketing, creative, digital, communications, business units, and external partners. This role combines operational leadership with hands-on project and program management and is responsible for developing scalable processes that support organizational growth and execution excellence. ABOUT THE ROLE: We are seeking a strategic, highly data-driven Director of Global Growth Marketing & Sales Enablement to serve as a key leader for our Ads business. This individual will own growth marketing strategy and execution while leading the ads insights, measurement, and analytics function. The role is responsible for translating complex advertising performance data into clear, actionable recommendations that drive revenue growth with advertisers and improve campaign effectiveness. You will work closely with sales, product, engineering, and the Head of Global Advertising to scale our advertising platform, strengthen advertiser relationships, and build best-in-class enablement programs. RESPONSIBILITIES: Lead and develop the growth marketing teams and the ads insights, measurement & analytics organization. Define and execute growth marketing strategies that increase advertiser acquisition, retention, and expansion. Own the end-to-end insights and measurement agenda: develop frameworks, dashboards, and analyses that surface performance drivers and opportunities across campaigns and advertisers. Turn advertising data and insights into prioritized, actionable recommendations that sales and account teams can use to increase revenue and campaign ROI. Build and scale sales enablement programs, including playbooks, training, competitive intelligence, case studies, and tools that equip the commercial organization to sell more effectively. Partner closely with Product and Engineering to influence roadmap priorities based on advertiser needs, performance gaps, and measurement requirements. Establish rigorous KPIs and reporting cadences for marketing effectiveness, advertiser health, and revenue impact. Drive cross-functional alignment on go-to-market motions, packaging, positioning, and value propositions for the Ads business. Recruit, mentor, and develop high-performing talent in marketing, analytics, and enablement. Represent SpaceXAI externally with key advertisers, agencies, and industry partners as needed. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS: 10+ years of progressive experience in growth marketing, digital advertising, measurement/analytics, or sales enablement, with significant time spent in advertising or social media platforms. Proven leadership experience managing marketing and/or analytics teams in a high-growth environment. Deep expertise in advertising measurement, attribution, experimentation, and performance analytics; demonstrated ability to convert insights into revenue-driving actions. Strong track record at prominent advertising platforms, social media companies, or ad-tech organizations (e.g., Meta, Google, TikTok, Snap, LinkedIn, Amazon Ads, or equivalent). Exceptional data fluency and comfort working with large-scale datasets, BI tools, and statistical concepts. Experience building sales enablement programs that demonstrably improve win rates, deal size, or advertiser retention. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; ability to influence senior leaders and cross-functional partners. Strategic thinker with a bias for action and a results-oriented mindset. Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree (MBA or quantitative field) preferred. PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE: Prior experience in a Director-level or equivalent role supporting a significant advertising revenue business. Familiarity with privacy-centric measurement, multi-touch attribution, media mix modeling, or advanced experimentation platforms. Experience operating in New York or other major advertising hubs with strong agency and brand relationships. COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS: $200,000 - $280,000 USD Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXAI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks. Develop value propositions that connect customer data, intelligence and activation to business outcomes. Build messaging for priority sectors, use cases and buying committees, including senior marketing, technology, data and business audiences. Bring Zeta’s portfolio together into a coherent customer story, helping buyers understand how relevant capabilities work together, where to begin and how Zeta can complement their existing technology investments and partner ecosystem. Ensure UK messaging accurately reflects product availability, deployment requirements and approved product claims. Develop and maintain competitive positioning, battlecards and objection-handling materials. Help commercial teams articulate meaningful differentiation against established marketing clouds, customer engagement platforms and specialist providers. Represent the UK customer, partner and market perspective in Global Product Marketing and Product discussions, bringing evidence of commercial opportunities, recurring customer needs and competitive gaps. Strategic Customer Growth and Enterprise Sales Partner with the GVP, Customer Growth, the GVP, Enterprise Sales and Key Account Directors (Impact Partners) to develop propositions that support customer retention, expansion, broader adoption of Zeta’s capabilities and selective enterprise new-logo growth. Translate strategic account priorities and commercial opportunities into clear customer narratives, use cases and value propositions. Help teams explain how relevant Zeta capabilities can address customer priorities, complement existing investments and deliver measurable business value. Develop value-led messaging for appropriate adoption of and upgrades to the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP), working with Product and Solutions Consulting to ensure technical and product accuracy. Partner with Customer Marketing, Global Communications and relevant partners to develop customer stories and proof points that demonstrate differentiated value. Translate customer success into credible material for sales conversations, executive thought leadership, partner activity and broader market-facing programmes. What You Will Bring Significant Product Marketing experience within SaaS, MarTech, customer engagement, data platforms or adjacent enterprise technology. A track record of developing differentiated positioning and propositions for complex enterprise solutions. Strong commercial understanding, with experience supporting both existing-customer growth and enterprise new-logo sales. Experience working with complex buying committees and translating technical capabilities into clear business value. Strong competitive intelligence and market-analysis capability, including experience using customer insight, field feedback and win-loss analysis. Strong understanding of the UK enterprise technology buying environment. The ability to influence effectively across Product, Marketing, Sales, Customer Growth, Partnerships and customer-facing teams. You understand that strong Product Marketing sits at the intersection of customer need, product capability, competitive differentiation and commercial opportunity. You build trusted relationships across functions and influence through insight, clarity and collaboration. Through giving, volunteering, grantmaking, employee resource groups and micro-actions, we help most of the Fortune 100 brands build better cultures and use their power for good. We’re also one of the first B Corporations in Canada, meaning we’re as committed to purpose as we are to profits. We have people working all over the world, including Canada, Spain, Switzerland, the United Kingdom, the United States and more! As our Demand Generation Manager, you will serve as a strategic marketer driving our Enterprise go-to-market (GTM) initiatives to generate a high-converting pipeline for Benevity’s global business. In this role, you will take ownership of a dedicated portfolio, designing and executing full-funnel demand generation strategies that elevate brand engagement and support revenue goals. Partnering closely with cross-functional teams, you will combine data-driven insights with creative execution to deliver exceptional client experiences while expanding our impact. What you’ll do: Develop and execute full-funnel demand generation strategies across webinars, email campaigns, and paid channels Align enterprise marketing initiatives with company-wide goals to maximize pipeline growth and revenue Partner with Product Marketing to translate positioning and target market insights into actionable campaigns Lead multi-channel campaigns that deliver engaging, outcome-focused experiences for prospective clients Collaborate with channel partners to identify and execute the most effective media mix for target audiences Own lead volume and pipeline targets, ensuring high-quality conversions that translate directly to business growth Foster strong interdepartmental relationships to ensure consistent messaging and seamless campaign execution Evaluate campaign performance using key analytics to continually optimize marketing programs Share data-driven insights and strategic recommendations with leadership to enhance overall results What you’ll bring: 3+ years of experience in demand generation or related marketing roles within B2B software or Enterprise SaaS Demonstrated success in designing and managing full-funnel enterprise marketing campaigns that drive pipeline growth Hands-on proficiency with key CRM and marketing automation platforms, specifically Salesforce and HubSpot Familiarity or experience with modern growth and outreach tools such as LinkedIn Campaign Manager and Clay Collaborative leadership approach with a proven ability to align cross-functional teams toward shared goals Strong analytical mind with a track record of translating marketing metrics into actionable campaign improvements Inclusive, clear communication style for sharing insights and influencing partners without direct authority Self-starter mindset paired with strong organizational skills to balance high-priority deliverables effectively Discover your purpose at work We’re not employees, we’re Benevity-ites. From all locations, backgrounds and walks of life, who deserve more … Innovative work. Growth opportunities. Caring co-workers. And a chance to do work that fills us with a sense of purpose. If the idea of working on tech that helps people do good in the world lights you up ... If you want a career where you’re valued for who you are and challenged to see who you can become … It’s time to join Benevity. We’re so excited to meet you. Where We Work At Benevity, we embrace a flexible hybrid approach to where we work that empowers our people in a way that supports great work, strong relationships, and personal well-being. For those located near one of our offices, while there’s no set requirement for in-office time, we do value the moments when coming together in person helps us build connection and collaboration. Whether it’s for onboarding, project work, or a chance to align and bond as a team, we trust our people to make thoughtful decisions about when showing up in person matters most. Join a company where DEIB isn’t a buzzword Diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging are part of Benevity’s DNA. You’ll see the impact of our massive investment in DEIB daily — from our well-supported employee resources groups to the exceptional diversity on our leadership and tech teams. We know that diverse backgrounds, experiences, skills and passions are what move our business and our people forward, so we're committed to creating a culture of belonging with equal opportunities for everyone to shine. That starts with a fair and accessible hiring process. If you want to feel seen, heard and celebrated, you belong at Benevity. Candidates with disabilities who may require accommodations throughout the hiring or assessment process are encouraged to reach out to accommodations@benevity.com.

absent_records.title: Senior Growth Marketing Manager (Subscriptions)
absent_records.description: Who We Are Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 300+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, annual revenue now exceeds $100m USD and millions use our browser on on Mac , Windows , iOS , and Android , our search engine , and the DuckDuckGo subscription . We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai , which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place. Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place Your Team and Role Working on the Marketing & Communications Functional Team, you'll drive profitable acquisition of paid subscribers and work on related projects that aim to help millions of people take back control of their personal information. Recent projects include: Supporting strategy and planning for new paid advertising initiatives to profitably scale subscriptions Launching new ad channel tests and measuring incremental lift Executing in-market tests for new creative and messaging following a brand refresh As a Senior Growth Marketing Manager, you'll manage high priority marketing campaigns, including planning, hands-on execution, testing, optimization, and analysis to optimize spend and drive profitable paid subscriber growth. This role will help create and execute a new marketing program for paid subscriptions. You'll deliver results from new channel testing, creative testing, and by optimizing paid subscriber conversion. The right person is excited to prove that paid marketing growth and privacy-respecting advertising practices aren’t at odds — they’re our edge. You know how to use aggregate measurement, experimentation, and strong judgment rather than user-level targeting and tracking. About You 7+ years of experience in digital advertising roles, with 2+ years of experience in paid acquisition for freemium consumer subscription apps preferred. Demonstrated experience with both strategic planning and execution in digital marketing platforms (app store ads, paid social, mobile app networks) to profitably scale app subscriber growth. Hands-on expertise standing up paid subscription programs from scratch, with a track record of scaling subscriber growth profitably against LTV and payback — not just acquisition costs. Experience driving subscription growth within an established, high-traffic product where subscription revenue is a secondary — not primary — revenue model, preferred. Track record partnering with Engineering and Product to build and optimize landing pages, funnels, product experiences, and instrumentation. Ability to execute highly complex and ambiguous projects, working across business strategy and marketing tactics. Advanced analytical and measurement abilities, including app economics (payback, LTV), incrementality/lift testing, modeling, and data analysis. Excellent communication skills — you can clearly articulate recommendations and rationale, whether verbal or written. Compensation $178,500 USD annually and stock options. Compensation is transparent across the organization, and all team members within the same professional level and global region receive the same compensation. Eligibility for company-sponsored health benefits is limited to team members based in the United States. This program does not extend to team members located in other countries, such as Canada or the UK. Our Team Member Support Guide explains how we prioritize your wellbeing including paid parental leave, office setup, and co-working allowances. Hiring Process Hiring works best when it's a two-way street. Learn how we help you get to know DuckDuckGo, envision your future role here, and find out more about how we hire . Diversity, Equity and Inclusion DuckDuckGo provides equal work opportunities to all team members and applicants , and it prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type on the basis of race, color, ethnicity, caste, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by our policies or federal, state, or local laws. We want to ensure that our hiring process is accessible. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process because of a medical condition or disability, please send an email to careers@duckduckgo.com to let us know the nature of your request. Please note that You’ll be required to attend meetings on camera via video conferencing Expect to travel at least two times a year: once for our all-hands meetup and again for a team retreat (each around 4-5 days). While extenuating circumstances may impact attendance, everyone is strongly encouraged to attend. While we offer a flexible work arrangement with no core hours, expect an average full-time commitment of 40 hours per week. A successful candidate must pass a background check as a condition of joining the team. By applying for this role, you confirm that all information submitted is accurate and complete. You further acknowledge that providing false or fraudulent information during the application process is cause for denial of an offer, revocation of any existing offer, or other adverse action, up to and including termination after the start of your commencement of work. Disclosure Statement: Use of AI in Hiring Process As part of our commitment to enhancing our recruitment process, we utilize artificial intelligence (AI) technology to assist in reviewing and summarizing job applications and test projects, including those tools integrated into our recruitment vendor platforms. We use AI to flag potentially fraudulent applications, analyze and summarize applicants’ experience, interviews, and project performance, and help streamline our selection process. Key Principles: Data Privacy: All information provided in your application will be handled in accordance with our Recruiting Privacy Policy . We ensure that your personal information is protected and used solely for recruitment purposes. Human Oversight and Accountability: The AI technology is designed to support our hiring team by providing insights and summaries of applications and evaluations of test projects against scoring rubrics. All final evaluations and hiring decisions, however, will be made by our hiring team, who will consider the AI's input alongside other factors. Transparency: We believe in transparency regarding our hiring practices. If you have any questions about how AI is used in our recruitment process, please feel free to reach out to us. By submitting your application, you acknowledge and consent to the use of AI technology in our review process. If you would like to request an alternative selection process, please contact us as at careers@duckduckgo.com . Thank you for your interest in joining DuckDuckGo!

absent_records.title: Product Growth Marketing Manager, Lifecycle & GTM Systems
absent_records.description: About KidKare The people who care for and feed children every day have enough on their plates. Their software shouldn't add to it. For more than 30 years, KidKare has built technology for the people behind childcare and child nutrition, helping them spend less time on paperwork, compliance, and administrative work and more time focused on the children and communities they serve. Our roots run deep in the Child and Adult Care Food Program (CACFP), a federal nutrition program that helps provide healthy meals and snacks to children and adults across the country. Today, we're building on that expertise with a growing ecosystem of software supporting childcare organizations across food program compliance, business management, professional development, and licensing. We're growing into new products, new markets, and have a much bigger vision for what KidKare can do for the childcare community. To support these goals, we're looking for a Product Growth Marketing Manager, Lifecycle & GTM Systems to build and run the engine that turns our product value into pipeline, adoption, and revenue. Position Summary This is an execution-first growth role. You'll partner with Product and Revenue Operations leadership to define the positioning and value proposition for each product, then put them to work: translating individual product propositions and features into audience-specific messaging and deploying that messaging through various tactics. You’ll be involved in managing the CRM, data enrichment, prospect scoring, routing, & lifecycle marketing. You'll report to our VP of Revenue Operations and work across Product, Sales, and Customer Growth to turn every launch and feature release into measurable pipeline, adoption, and expansion. In a given week you might ship a new CRM workflow, tune a fit-and-intent scoring model, launch a demand-gen test to a newly enriched segment, build an app telemtry guide for a feature release, fix a routing rule that's sending leads to the wrong queue, or walk leadership through what moved in the funnel and why. You'll build the machine, and you'll run it. You'll partner closely with our Digital Marketing Manager, who owns brand, creative, content, and channel execution. You'll own the systems, segmentation, lifecycle logic, experiment design, and measurement that make that work reach the right audience at the right moment. Together, you'll turn product and market insight into demand. Primary Responsibilities Positioning, Feature Messaging & Launch Execution • Partner with product leadership to define and refine positioning and value propositions for each product and major release, grounded in customer, competitive, and market insight. • Translate individual product features and releases into audience-specific messaging (the value, the proof, and the call to action) for each persona and segment we serve, carrying positioning down to the feature level. • Execute launches through the systems you manage: target segments, lifecycle and nurture workflows, in-app guides, sales sequences and snippets, with launch tiers matched to the size of the release. • Package features into the battlecards, talk tracks, and objection handling our Sales and Customer Growth teams need, delivered inside CRM where reps actually work. CRM Management & GTM Systems • Manage the CRM as the system of record for marketing and lifecycle: data model, custom properties, lifecycle stages, lead status, lists and segments, forms, and workflow automation. • Maintain CRM data quality and governance, including deduplication, field standards, consistent deal stages across pipelines, and clear documentation, so Sales, Customer Growth, and leadership trust the data. • Orchestrate the GTM stack (CRM, app telemtry, data enrichment, and automation tools) so product, marketing, and sales data flow cleanly between systems. Enrichment, AI Scoring & Routing • Build and maintain enrichment workflows that close firmographic, contact, and segment data gaps, including vertical-specific sources relating to childcare, education, and food program participation data. • Design, deploy, and continuously tune fit, intent, and product-usage scoring models, using AI and predictive approaches where they outperform rules-based logic. • Own lead and account routing rules, handoff SLAs, and alerts to Sales and Customer Growth, and monitor speed-to-lead and conversion by route. Demand Generation Experiments • Run a structured demand-gen experimentation program: define the hypothesis, audience, channel, offer, success metric, and decision rule before launch, then scale or move to the next experiment based on results. • Build and execute campaigns, nurture tracks, and outbound sequences against enriched, scored segments, partnering with the Digital Marketing Manager on creative and channel execution. • Use customer, competitive, and market insight to surface new segments and opportunities worth testing, and maintain a prioritized backlog and a visible results log so learnings compound. Lifecycle & In-App Engagement • Own lifecycle programs across the customer journey: onboarding, activation, feature adoption, cross-sell and expansion, renewal, and win-back. • Build behavior-triggered journeys that combine CRM email and telemetry in-app guides, driven by product usage signals rather than calendar cadence alone. • Partner with Product and Customer Growth to identify adoption gaps and cross-sell opportunities across our product portfolio, and run the programs that close them. Funnel Reporting & Measurement • Support maintenance of funnel stage definitions and conversion logic from first touch through closed-won, activation, and expansion. • Build and own dashboards and recurring funnel reporting for RevOps and leadership, covering pipeline, conversion rates, velocity, channel and campaign performance, and product adoption. • Set attribution and experiment measurement standards, and translate the numbers into clear recommendations on where to invest next. We care about great marketing, but ultimately we care about whether it drives growth. What Success Looks Like • First 90 days: You've aligned with product leadership on positioning for priority products; audited HubSpot data, lifecycle stages, and routing; published agreed funnel definitions; shipped a baseline funnel dashboard; and launched your first experiments. • First 6 months: Enrichment and scoring are live and routing leads to Sales and Customer Growth against defined SLAs; core onboarding and adoption journeys are running across email and in-app; and experiments ship on a steady cadence with documented results. • First 12 months: Every feature release runs through a repeatable launch playbook executed in the stack; conversion, speed-to-lead, and product adoption show measurable lift; and leadership uses your funnel reporting to make investment decisions. You'll Probably Love This Role If… • You're a builder who loves making the machine work, not just drawing the diagram. You'd rather ship the test than debate it. • You're curious about customers, competitors, and markets and naturally find yourself asking, “Where's the opportunity here?” • You read a feature release and immediately think about the segment, the trigger, the channel, and the metric. • Messy CRM data bothers you, and you'd rather fix it at the source than patch it in a spreadsheet. • You think in funnels and can explain, in plain language, why a conversion rate moved. • You use AI as a force multiplier in real workflows, from enrichment and scoring to research and content variants, and you know where it helps and where it doesn't. • You’re a natural collaborative and aren’t afraid to step outside of the RevOps team to work with Product, Sales, Customer Growth, and leadership. • You're comfortable owning your work end to end without needing a huge team around you. • You're excited to build the GTM engine rather than inherit a finished one. Required Qualifications • 4+ years in growth marketing, lifecycle marketing, marketing operations, revenue operations, or GTM engineering or a related B2B SaaS role. • Hands-on CRM management/ownership as an admin or power user, including properties, lifecycle stages, workflows, lists, scoring, and reporting. • Experience partnering with product leadership to define positioning and value propositions, and a proven ability to translate individual features into audience-specific messaging deployed across campaigns, lifecycle programs, in-app experiences, and sales enablement. • Experience building data enrichment, lead scoring, and routing, including AI or predictive scoring approaches. • A track record of designing and running demand-gen experiments with clear hypotheses, success metrics, and documented outcomes. • Experience building behavior-triggered lifecycle programs across email and in-app channels. • Strong funnel reporting and analytics skills: defining stages and conversion metrics, building dashboards, and working comfortably with data in spreadsheets or BI tools. • Clear, concise writing, from lifecycle copy to experiment readouts to leadership summaries. • Strong project management and systems thinking, with a habit of documenting what you build. • A builder mentality and the ability to move comfortably between strategy and hands-on execution. Preferred Qualifications Experience with CACFP, childcare, child nutrition, education, government programs, or other regulated industries is a huge plus, but not a requirement. CACFP has its own language, regulations, acronyms, and complexities. If you already know it, amazing. If you don't, you'll be surrounded by an exceptional team of people who do, and we'll help you get up to speed. A few other things we'd love to see: • Experience with vertical SaaS, multi-product portfolios, or marketing to both SMB and enterprise or public-sector buyers. • CRM certifications (Marketing, Sales, or Operations related) or hands-on experience with CRM AI and data enrichment features. • Hands-on experience with in-app engagement or product adoption platforms • Experience with enrichment and GTM automation tools • Technical comfort beyond the UI: SQL, APIs and webhooks, or light scripting (JavaScript or Python) to connect systems and automate workflows. • Comfort building AI-powered workflows for research, enrichment, scoring, and content variation. You know how to make AI your copilot, not your copywriter. Why KidKare? We're at an exciting inflection point, taking decades of experience in childcare and child nutrition and using it to build a broader ecosystem of products for the organizations and people who help care for our communities. You won't be starting from scratch. We've invested deeply in understanding our customers, markets, competitors, and products. But we're not handing you a finished machine and asking you to keep it running. We want you to build the engine that powers what comes next. If you want to own the systems, run the experiments, build the lifecycle, measure the funnel, and see exactly how your work moves pipeline and adoption, you'll have plenty to dig into here. All qualified applicants will be afforded equal employment opportunities without discrimination because of race, creed, color, national origin, sex, age, disability, or marital status. #KidKare

absent_records.title: Paid Search Strategist, DTC eCommerce (Remote)
absent_records.description: Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked. That is the whole job. Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business. So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face. At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero. You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end. Here is what "end to end" actually means. You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result. You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme. You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number. You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output. If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast. If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading. Requirements What the job looks like Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt You are a fit if You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search You are fluent in the whole stack, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too You are not a fit if "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed You want to be told what to do this week You need a ticketing system to know what matters You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question Benefits Why this role is exciting This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency. You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale. You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident. You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

absent_records.description: What is PerfectServe ? PerfectServe is a leading provider of clinical communication and physician scheduling solutions in the health IT space. PerfectServe now has 400+ employees, 30,000+ customers — spanning medical practices, hospitals, and health systems — and $100 million+ in annual revenue. PerfectServe’s mission is to accelerate speed to care by optimizing provider schedules and routing communications — including messages, pages, calls, and alerts — to the right place at the right time in any care setting. By facilitating real-time information sharing, building better schedules, and automating important clinical workflows, we believe we can help our customers advance patient care and improve the well-being of their clinicians. Leading analyst firms like Gartner® and KLAS Research have consistently validated our approach: In 2026, PerfectServe was named highest in execution and furthest in vision in the Gartner Magic Quadrant™ for Clinical Communication and Collaboration — the clear segment leader. PerfectServe also received two Best in KLAS awards in 2026 — one for physician scheduling and another for ambulatory clinical communications. That makes for 11 Best in KLAS awards over the past 9 years. At PerfectServe, you'll have a unique opportunity to join a collaborative team with decades of experience that finds new ways to delight our customers every day. This involves consistent efforts to stay on the cutting edge of product development, which includes everything from implementing AI in new and existing solutions to brainstorming with customers about novel workflows. But you don't have to be in product to make in impact — everybody at PerfectServe contributes to important work that moves the business forward. If you're looking for a well-established, tech-forward company full of smart people doing meaningful work, you've found the right place! The Opportunity You own two things that are easy to under-invest in and expensive to ignore: the customers we already have, and the rooms where buyers gather. You run customer and expansion marketing in partnership with Customer Success, and you execute the field and event motion that the segment owners scope. You also own the proof. References, case studies, and advocates are how we win deals and how an acquirer values us. That program is yours to build. What You’ll Own Sales enablement Build custom sales decks and assets for client engagements, with a focus on enterprise deals. Run broader enablement: operationalize the master pitch and battlecards PMM owns, onboard reps to the materials, and keep deal assets current. Be the bridge between marketing’s narrative and what reps actually present in the room. Field and event execution Execute the events the segment owners scope and recommend: booth, on-site meetings, and follow-through. Own on-site ROI and the pre- and post-event motion with sales and CS. References, case studies, and advocacy Own the reference and advocacy program; recruit advocates and turn outcomes into proof. Partner with Content to produce and PMM for the outcome data. Field enablement Own field and event enablement materials in partnership with PMM’s core positioning. What You Don’t Own New-logo demand creation — the segment owners. Which events we attend (the thesis) — segment owners decide; you execute. Core positioning and battlecards — PMM. Key Performance Indicators Expansion pipeline influenced. Customer and expansion pipeline, with Customer Success. Net revenue retention contribution. Marketing’s influence on retention and expansion. Event execution ROI. Pipeline and qualified meetings per event, on budget. Proof produced. References and case studies created — exit-critical. Field contribution to acute pipeline. Field-influenced pipeline supporting the ABM motion. What We’re Looking For 4+ years in customer marketing, field marketing, or events in B2B SaaS; healthcare IT preferred. A program builder who can run events and customer motions at the same time without dropping either. Comfort partnering closely with Customer Success and Sales. A reference and advocacy track record. An AI-first approach to scaling field and customer content. Ability to travel up to 25% travel Nice to Have Experience building a customer advocacy or reference program from scratch. Experience supporting diligence with customer proof points. Why Join PerfectServe? At PerfectServe, we are transforming healthcare communication and collaboration to help clinicians deliver better care. You’ll work with a dedicated and mission-driven team in an environment that values growth, transparency, and innovation. We offer a salary range of $75,000-$85,000 USD per year, with compensation tailored to your background, strengths, and potential to grow within the team. The salary range listed for this role reflects our commitment to pay transparency and is based on market data, internal equity, and the scope of responsibilities. compensation will be determined by a combination of factors, including the candidate’s experience, skills, and the specific team or product area they support. We regularly review compensation across the company to ensure fairness and consistency. If you are a current employee and have questions about how your compensation aligns with our ranges, we encourage you to speak with your manager or People Operations. Benefits: Remote first work environment Health, Dental, Vision, Life and Disability Insurance options available day one. 401K - with match and immediately vested. 17 company holidays, 2 floating holidays plus competitive paid time off policy Internal Advancement Opportunities PerfectServe offers unified healthcare communication solutions to help physicians, nurses, and care team members provide exceptional patient care. PerfectServe’s cloud-based solutions enhance patient safety and reduce provider burnout by automating workflows, speeding time to treatment, optimizing shift schedules, empowering nurse mobility, and engaging patients in their own care.

absent_records.title: Growth Marketing Manager
absent_records.description: Are you obsessed with data, partner success, taking action, and changing the game? If you have a whole lot of hustle and a touch of nerd, come work with Pattern! We want you to use your skills to push one of the fastest-growing companies headquartered in the US to the top of the list. Pattern accelerates brands on global ecommerce marketplaces leveraging proprietary technology and AI. Utilizing more than 66 trillion data points, sophisticated machine learning and AI models, Pattern optimizes and automates all levers of ecommerce growth for global brands, including advertising, content management, logistics and fulfillment, pricing, forecasting and customer service. Hundreds of global brands depend on Pattern’s ecommerce acceleration platform every day to drive profitable revenue growth across 60+ global marketplaces—including Amazon, Walmart.com , Target.com , eBay, Tmall, TikTok Shop, JD, and Mercado Libre. To learn more, visit pattern.com or email press@pattern.com . Pattern has been named one of the fastest growing tech companies headquartered in North America by Deloitte and one of best-led companies by Inc. We place employee experience at the center of our business model and have been recognized as one of Newsweek’s Global Most Loved Workplaces®. We need a Digital Advertising Strategist to help transform our digital advertising team into a data-driven performance machine. We want our team members to be proactive and persistent until they are able to turn data into profitable insights for our customers and partners alike. We are looking for someone with extremely high standards who is efficient and not afraid to roll up their sleeves and do what it takes to help our partners be successful. If you are intelligent, organized, and a high-energy builder, we encourage you to apply. This is a full-time role and will work a hybrid schedule (three days in office, two days remote per week) based in Lehi, Utah. \n What is a day in the life of a Digital Advertising Strategist? Manage and delegate the creation of PPC and display campaigns across Amazon, Walmart, Google, Facebook, etc. Perform market research to build tailored and relevant full-funnel strategies for clients Nurture partner relationships by meeting regularly to review performance, negotiate advertising budgets, and discuss strategy ideas Research and test effective keywords, bidding strategies, and ad copy to catalyze traffic and sales velocity Collaborate with the brand management team to align advertising goals with the internal ambitions set by our partners What will I need to thrive in this role? Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications or a related program 2+ years of experience in digital marketing, preferably in paid search and display advertising (Google Ads, Facebook, etc.) Demonstrable Excel knowledge, data analysis, and problem solving skills Prior experience in managing client relationships and communicating with key internal & external partners Demonstrable quickness in learning new things and an ambitious attitude Preferred Qualifications: Working history with the Amazon advertising platform and third party tools like Helium 10, Pacvue, Viral Launch, etc. Knowledge of advanced auto-bid tools, such as Marin or DS3 Skills in web analytics and relevant attribution models Experience in retail revenue strategy What does high performance look like? You are agile and experimental, bringing new ideas and moving fast to achieve goals You are self-driven, organized, and proactive mindset with high ethical standards You love web analytics, attribution models, and are up to speed on all the latest trends You follow through with all assignments in a timely manner You give 100% to all tasks and projects you are given You will take full ownership of your projects and follow through to completion What is my potential for career growth? You will learn valuable skills in Amazon Ads, leadership, and marketplace strategy as well as build relationships with department leaders at Pattern and brand executives. These skills and relationships can lead to career advancement within the company. We are passionate about developing our amazing talent and providing excellent opportunities for career growth within Pattern. What does success look like in the first 30, 60, 90 days? 30 Days - you have your team schedule and structure established with regular 1:1s, you build strong relationships with team members, brand managers, and brand partners 60 Days - you hold regular strategy sessions to share valuable suggestions with brand partners 90 Days - you build and execute successful ad strategies and understand the nuances of your brands’ advertising needs What is the team like? You will work with the other Associate Directors and Ad Strategists and be supervised by the Director of Digital Advertising. You will also be mentored by the VP of Advertising and meet with them on a regular basis to discuss your performance. This team is data driven and results oriented. You will collaborate regularly with members of your team to implement actionable solutions. Ideas and input are encouraged from all members. We want individuals who are: Game Changers- A game changer is someone who looks at problems with an open mind and shares new ideas with team members, regularly reassesses existing plans and attaches a realistic timeline to goals, makes profitable, productive, and innovative contributions, and actively pursues improvements to Pattern’s processes and outcomes. Data Fanatics- A data fanatic is someone who recognizes problems and seeks to understand them through data, draws unbiased conclusions based on data that lead to actionable solutions, and continues to track the effects of the solutions using data. Partner Obsessed- An individual who is partner obsessed clearly explains the status of projects to partners and relies on constructive feedback, actively listens to partner’s expectations and delivers results that exceed them, prioritizes the needs of your partners, and takes the time to create a personable experience for those interacting with Pattern. Team of Doers- Someone who is a part of team of doers uplifts team members and recognizes their specific contributions, takes initiative to help in any circumstance, actively contributes to supporting improvements, and holds themselves accountable to the team as well as to partners. What is the hiring process? Initial phone interview with Pattern’s talent acquisition team Video interview with a hiring manager Onsite interview with a panel of department leaders Professional reference checks Executive review Offer How can I stand out as an applicant? Be prepared to talk about professional accomplishments with specific data to quantify examples Be ready to talk about how you can add value and be the best addition to the team Focus on mentioning how you would make a difference at Pattern Be prepared to talk about any side projects related to data and analytics \n Why should I work at Pattern? Pattern offers big opportunities to make a difference in the ecommerce industry! We are a company full of talented people that evolves quickly and often. We set big goals, work tirelessly to achieve them, and we love our Pattern community. We also believe in having fun and balancing our lives, so we offer awesome benefits that include: - Unlimited PTO - Paid Holidays - Onsite Fitness Center - Company Paid Life Insurance - Casual Dress Code - Competitive Pay - Health, Vision, and Dental Insurance - 401(k) match. Pattern matches 100% of the first 3% in eligible compensation deferred and 50% of the next 2% in eligible compensation deferred. Pattern provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability, status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.
